arm.source: stall torques at 4.8-5 V: DSServo DS3218 18 kg.cm @5 V, TowerPro MG996R 9.4 kg.cm @4.8 V, MG90S 1.8 kg.cm @4.8 V; verify on arrival
arm.servo_limits_source: N5: 4.8 V is the lower end of all three data sheets (DS3218 4.8-6.8 V, MG996R 4.8-6.6 V, MG90S 4.8-6 V) and the voltage the stall torques above hold at, so TL4 checks it at the servo connector under load; 55 C is the top of the MG996R operating range, read conservatively as a case limit measured beside the motor

mg996r_mm.source: Handsontec MG996R drawing; verify on arrival

mg90s_mm.source: TowerPro MG90S drawing; verify on arrival

horn_25t_mm.note: aluminium 25T disc horn, 4 x M3 tapped on horn_pcd_mm

gripper.type: twin geared claw (M01, DD93): jaw A on the MG90S horn, jaw B on an M3 pin in the palm post
gripper.source: open_poses: the CAD sweeps every jaw angle there and every edge between two of them with the jaws open (manifest gripper); release_poses: over the cargo bin, where the claw only lets go; a close anywhere else may hold an object (DD94)

head.note: DD83: pan MG90S on the neck axis, 6804 carries the neck; tilt MG90S hidden in the neck housing, pushrod to the left eye

motor.source: Seeed 114090046 drawing (130 rpm 1:45: 4.4 kg.cm, 0.9 kg.cm rated, 1.8 A); 1:78 torques ratio-scaled from it; 11 PPR channel A both edges; ratio, PPR, winding resistance and stall current verify on arrival

motor_driver.source: Toshiba TB6612FNG datasheet 2026-05-13: Operating Range (VM <= 13.5 V, IOUT <= 1.0 A at VM >= 4.5 V) and Absolute Maximum Ratings (1.2 A ave; 2 A only for 20 ms pulses at <= 20 % duty)
